import sys
from collections import deque

MAXN = 300

ROOM = -1
REAC = -2
BAD_REAC = -3
CAPS = ROOM

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, frm, to, rev, flow, cap):
        self.frm = frm
        self.to = to
        self.rev = rev
        self.flow = flow
        self.cap = cap

    def residuo(self):
        return self.cap - self.flow

class EdmondsKarp:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.graph = [[] for _ in range(size)]
        self.prev = [None] * size
        self.vis = [False] * size

    def add(self, s, t, cap):
        a = Edge(s, t, len(self.graph[t]), 0, cap)
        b = Edge(t, s, len(self.graph[s]), 0, 0)
        self.graph[s].append(a)
        self.graph[t].append(b)

    def undirectedAdd(self, s, t, cap):
        a = Edge(s, t, len(self.graph[t]), 0, cap)
        b = Edge(t, s, len(self.graph[s]), 0, cap)
        self.graph[s].append(a)
        self.graph[t].append(b)

    def bfs(self, source, sink):
        for i in range(self.size):
            self.prev[i] = None
            self.vis[i] = False

        q = deque()
        q.append(source)
        self.vis[source] = True

        while q:
            atual = q.popleft()
            if atual == sink:
                return True
            for a in self.graph[atual]:
                if not self.vis[a.to] and a.residuo() > 0:
                    self.prev[a.to] = a
                    self.vis[a.to] = True
                    q.append(a.to)
        return False

    def dfs(self, source, sink):
        flow = float('inf')
        v = sink
        while v != source:
            flow = min(flow, self.prev[v].residuo())
            v = self.prev[v].frm

        v = sink
        while v != source:
            a = self.prev[v]
            a.flow += flow
            self.graph[a.to][a.rev].flow -= flow
            v = a.frm
        return flow

    def flow(self, source, sink):
        total_flow = 0
        while self.bfs(source, sink):
            total_flow += self.dfs(source, sink)
        return total_flow

station = [[0]*MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
checkpoint = [[0]*MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
veneno = [[[0]*MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)] for _ in range(61)]

class Coord:
    def __init__(self, x, y, qtd):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.qtd = qtd

    def is_valid(self, N):
        return 0 <= self.x < N and 0 <= self.y < N and station[self.x][self.y] == ROOM

def is_valid(x, y, N):
    return Coord(x, y, 0).is_valid(N)

def coord_eq(a, b):
    return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y

pessoas = []
capsulas = []
moveX = [-1, 0, 1, 0]  # ^ < v >
moveY = [0, -1, 0, 1]  # ^ < v >

def trad(ch):
    if ch.isdigit():
        return ROOM
    elif ch == 'Y':
        return REAC
    elif ch == 'Z':
        return BAD_REAC
    return -1

def how_much(ch):
    return int(ch)

def bfs(from_coord, to_coord, N):
    vis = [[False]*N for _ in range(N)]
    q = deque()
    q.append((0, from_coord))
    vis[from_coord.x][from_coord.y] = True

    while q:
        tempo, atual = q.popleft()
        if coord_eq(atual, to_coord):
            return tempo

        if veneno[tempo][atual.x][atual.y]:
            continue

        for i in range(4):
            nx = atual.x + moveX[i]
            ny = atual.y + moveY[i]
            if is_valid(nx, ny, N) and not vis[nx][ny]:
                if not veneno[tempo][nx][ny]:
                    q.append((tempo + 1, Coord(nx, ny, 0)))
                    vis[nx][ny] = True
    return 999

def espalha_veneno(x, y, T, N):
    veneno[0][x][y] = 1
    for i in range(1, T+1):
        for lin in range(N):
            for col in range(N):
                if veneno[i-1][lin][col]:
                    veneno[i][lin][col] = 1
                    for move in range(4):
                        nl = lin + moveX[move]
                        nc = col + moveY[move]
                        if is_valid(nl, nc, N):
                            veneno[i][nl][nc] = 1

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    T = int(next(it))

    bad = Coord(0, 0, 0)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            ch = next(it)
            val = trad(ch)
            if val == ROOM and how_much(ch):
                pessoas.append(Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)))
            station[i][j] = val
            if val == BAD_REAC:
                bad = Coord(i, j, 0)

    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            ch = next(it)
            if trad(ch) == CAPS and how_much(ch):
                capsulas.append(Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)))
                checkpoint[i][j] = how_much(ch)

    din = EdmondsKarp(MAXN)
    sink = MAXN - 1

    for i, p in enumerate(pessoas):
        din.add(0, i*2+1, p.qtd)

    for i, c in enumerate(capsulas):
        din.add(i*2+2, sink, c.qtd)

    espalha_veneno(bad.x, bad.y, T, N)

    for i, p in enumerate(pessoas):
        for j, c in enumerate(capsulas):
            tempo = bfs(p, c, N)
            if tempo <= T:
                din.add(i*2+1, j*2+2, 999)

    print(din.flow(0, sink))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
